title: Boterkoek (Dutch Butter Cake)
hookLine: Netherlands-inspired boterkoek (dutch butter cake) with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven to 180°C/350˚F (conventional oven). Place the softened butter and sugar in the bowl of a stand mixer and whisk until creamy. Add the flour and salt and knead by hand until you have a smooth dough. Divide into two pieces. Incorporate {m53385_1}, {m53385_2}, {m53385_3}, and {m53385_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Line the base of a square or round cake tin with baking parchment (not a springform tin) and place the first half of the pastry on top. Flatten with your fingers and a spoon. Using a teaspoon, sprinkle dollops of dulce de leche over the base. Sprinkle with the chopped chocolate and cover with the second half of the pastry. This is a bit trickier, but if you don’t get it right, don’t worry, it’ll be fine once it’s baked! Brush the pastry with the beaten egg. Incorporate {m53385_5}, {m53385_6}, and {m53385_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Bake Boterkoek (Dutch Butter Cake) & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 30 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake in the oven for about 30 minutes or until golden brown. It will be wobbly. That's because butter cake only firms up when it cools. Cut into small pieces when it has cooled completely! Storing: Store in an airtight container outside of the fridge for about 2-3 days or in the fridge for 5 days. Freeze for up to three months.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
